title: [finding] AGENTS.md's governed-surface section disagrees with the fleet on root skills/** — and its "this repo has NO mechanical backstop" paragraph is now false, the guard workflow it promised to mention is live
body:
Filed by the objectstack skills lane seat (session `session_01EXxTW8mvPBhoHxmyPZ63de`, PM loop round 1), surfaced live by the ui#5759 dispatch: the dev hit the disagreement mid-run on PR #6865, reported it as a deviation instead of silently resolving it, and took the stricter path (draft-only). ⛔ No `domain:*` set — triage's field; on the routing judgement this is `domain:skills` (the landing file is this repo's `AGENTS.md`, an instruction-architecture face).

Two separable defects, both landing in `AGENTS.md`'s 受管面 section (~:360–392 on `origin/main` today — re-derive before acting).

## 1. Root `skills/**`: two governing texts, two answers

- **This repo's AGENTS.md (deliberate, reasoned):** root `skills/**` (the published tree, e.g. `skills/objectui/`) is **NOT** governed — "按普通代码 PR 走:CI 全绿就照上面的常规路径自行入队合并", with the warning that over-conservative misreads also cost ("曾有 agent 把发布用的 `skills/` 当成「维护者专属」而不敢挂 auto-merge…往保守方向误判同样是误判").
- **The fleet side (objectstack pm-dispatch SKILL.md):** the governed-surface definition (maintainer 2026-08-18 「同意」) includes `skills/**`, and the skills lane's md-content rule (maintainer 2026-08-26) routes any lane PR whose diff contains a `.md` file to maintainer review. The published corpus is also the subject of the 2026-08-21 whole-package ruling ("对外发布的 skills 是整个平台的最大价值…").

⇒ For a published-corpus prose PR in this repo, one text says "self-merge on green", the other says "maintainer reviews". PR #6865 (ui#5759) hit this today; the dev's resolution — draft-only, since it satisfies both — is correct behaviour but leaves the disagreement standing for the next seat, and the next seat may follow the local text and self-merge published-corpus changes with no human eye.

⚠️ This half is a **convention adjudication about governance strength for a published-value surface — a human-floor question**, not something a seat rules. The card records both readings so the grader can put the choice (align objectui's local text to the fleet set, or carve published `skills/**` out fleet-wide with the local rationale) in front of the maintainer.

## 2. The "no mechanical backstop" paragraph is measurably false now

`AGENTS.md:392` states: 「**本仓没有任何机械兜底,这一段就是全部。** 本仓没有 CODEOWNERS…受管面上没有 required check、没有钩子,也没有事后审计…哪天本仓真有了检测,它会写在这里。」

Measured on `origin/main` today: `.github/workflows/governed-surface-guard.yml` exists (the machine half of the no-bypass rule, objectui#6596, delegating to `scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`), and the `Governed Surface Queue Guard` check ran and reported on PR #6865 this morning. The paragraph's own closing promise ("它会写在这里") is the fix instruction: name the guard, its report-only-vs-blocking state (per #6596, the ruleset toggle is still with the maintainer — `pm:awaiting-maintainer`), and what it does and does not catch. This half is a plain staleness fix and does not need the half-1 adjudication.

## Re-check

```
git grep -n "本仓没有任何机械兜底" origin/main -- AGENTS.md
ls .github/workflows/governed-surface-guard.yml && git grep -ln "Governed Surface Queue Guard" origin/main -- .github/workflows/
git grep -n "不在受管面上" origin/main -- AGENTS.md
```

⛔ Reverse-check any zero against 「受管面」 in the same file. ⚠️ `AGENTS.md` here is itself governed — any fix PR stays draft for human merge, whatever half-1's outcome.

## Duplicate check

Searched this round (instrument alive — the same query returned the five governance neighbours): #5149 (closed — where the governed rule landed here), #6596 (open, `pm:awaiting-maintainer` — the machine half's ruleset toggle; ADJACENT: it makes half 2 stale-r, it does not record either defect), #3243 / #6325 (closed — different subjects). ⛔ No open card covers either half.

## Refs

- ui#5759 / PR #6865 — where the disagreement fired live (see that PR's report deviation)
- objectui#6596 — the guard's arrival; objectui#5149 — the local governed rule's provenance
- objectstack pm-dispatch SKILL.md governed-surface definition + 2026-08-26 md-content split (the fleet-side texts)
